blocks.title: About
blocks.introHtml: Hi, I'm Hwan Heo (허환), an AI Research Engineer working across 3D AI and graphics. By day, I build 3D worlds with AI; by night, I'm usually wandering through music, guitar, or random STEM rabbit holes. This site is where I collect the work, notes, and experiments behind that mix.
blocks.name: Hwan Heo
blocks.bodyHtml: At NC AI, I lead research and engineering for the VARCO 3D team, developing production 3D AI systems across large-scale generative model training, inference optimization, and graphics algorithms. I hold both a B.S. and M.S. in Computer Science from Korea University, where I was advised by Professor Hyunwoo J. Kim. Previously, I was a Research Intern at NAVER AI Lab, mentored by Dr. Jin-Hwa Kim.

items.title: Hwan Heo | 허환
items.bodyHtml: AI Research Engineer with 3+ years of experience building production 3D AI systems across large-scale model training, inference optimization, neural rendering, and graphics algorithms.
bulletsHtml: AI Research Engineer at NC AI (NCSOFT)

items.titleHtml: Master of Computer Science & Engineering
items.bodyHtml: Studied advanced machine learning, computer vision, generalization and related areas, building a theoretical and practical foundation.

items.titleHtml: Bachelor of Computer Science & Engineering
items.bodyHtml: Gained a comprehensive understanding of computer science principles and engineering fundamentals through a rigorous undergraduate program.

bulletsHtml: Spearheaded the research and development of core algorithms for VARCO 3D, NC AI's flagship 3D generation service
Led research and development of 3D asset generation, focusing on 3D Latent Diffusion and Texture Synthesis: CaPa
Developed and applied novel Neural Rendering solutions, including:

• Integrated Gaussian Splatting into a proprietary game engine
  • Created a high-speed Neural Facial Avatar for multi-camera systems
Researched a novel neural rendering method using joint optimization of camera poses and hash grid radiance fields
